text: {"lessons":["I often sell positions after gains, but locking in a gain feels satisfying rather than proving it was the best decision.","Frequent selling has not prevented my account value from falling, so I should consider the whole portfolio and avoid trading just for the emotional reward of taking profits.","Past price moves do not predict future moves; I should make decisions based on my goals and current circumstances, not assume a recent winner or loser will keep moving the same way."]}
